g.aria-label: X-axis titled 'Time (UTC)' for a time scale with values from 14:18 to 14:36
Y-axis titled 'CPU %' for a linear scale with values from 0.0% to 160.0%
Symbol legend titled 'series' for stroke color with 9 values: sundial-cadvisor-1, sundial-grafana-1, sundial-loki-1, sundial-node-1, sundial-postgres-1, ending with sundial-tempo-1
